ember_core_invariants_surfaced: Attenuation is a monotone fold, so a capability chain is an IVC; proofs and capabilities belong in one design (2026-05-20).
Zero-knowledge proofs are an affordance offered when useful, not a requirement: 'an agent-centric disaggregated mina'.
One authorization semantics (Datalog) with trust as a deployment mode; the trusted and trustless uses must not be 'bolted onto each other'.
A proof must attest the actual decision or transition, not an adjacent fact; 'not cheating along the way'.
Value conservation across named cells and notes: excess must net to zero; sum(spent) + sum(withdrawals) = sum(created) + sum(deposits).
A note is a cell with a consume-once lifecycle, not a second system; nullifiers must not depend on where state is hosted.
Autarky: validity never depends on federation membership; solo operation is the n = 1 case of the same code path; a member can 'peel out'.
Acceptor validates freshness; revocation is asynchronous by nature; 'Full synchrony can be implemented on top'.
The holder proves non-revocation; the revoker does not enumerate the subtree.
Participants are responsible for storing their own state; the federation is a notary and ordering service, and a sovereign cell's registered state is 'some extremely fancy preimage'.
A cell's identity is bound to the verification key of the program that governs its transitions.
Progressive disclosure is a per-interaction choice over a fixed program; it is the reason for in-circuit Datalog evaluation.
Golden Vision: the algebraic proof constrains all cap and turn operations, and receipt chains plus witness data suffice to replay the protocol.
The system needs a symbolic deductive model showing a property is carried along through composed proofs; this became the Lean metatheory.
The Rust turn/ executor is not an oracle; matching it locks in known wrongness. The Lean executor is the real one, reached over FFI.
Conservation is not full semantic correctness; soundness must pin the whole post-state via an injective state commitment (anti-ghost).
Exactly one circuit, one VK, one Lean-derived algebraic statement; many executor and witness-generator implementations may share it.
Tests passing is not evidence unless it is known what the tests test; no 'structural' tests; in-browser simulations are never acceptable.
All proof backends live alongside each other in one repository so they can be compared; no feature flags that hide composition bugs.

VK freedom: the verifying key may change at will; no cargo cults about VK epochs or backwards compatibility in a lab-stage greenfield project.

Cryptographic carriers must be satisfiable, non-vacuous hypotheses on abstract functions, never axioms from which absurdity could follow.
